subject.title: BL-ecommerce-product: Product Page — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should the Product Page BL block proceed through MiguelHamelyn's F2 validation before any isolation or tests are merged?
rationale: The repository BL pipeline makes owner validation blocking, and this block spans multiple live product-page business rules plus already-open divergence issues.

options.title: Continue owner-led BL pipeline

options.title: Defer Product Page BL extraction
